design_intent: Keep the desktop article navigation visible as the reader scrolls, while preserving a compact, non-intrusive mobile disclosure. The navigation should remain easy to scan, never cover content, and stay inside the article grid.
acceptance_criteria: The desktop In this article navigation uses sticky positioning below the site header.
The desktop navigation remains within the article column and does not overlap the article body.
The desktop navigation has a bounded viewport height and can scroll internally when the list is taller than the viewport.
The mobile navigation remains a disclosure element and does not become sticky.
Anchor headings remain visible below the fixed reading-progress/header area when jumped to.
There is no horizontal overflow at 375px, 768px, or 1440px.
